transport.rule: An H4 transport includes its packet-type octet; an in-process transport may carry the type separately. Validate the complete declared length before dispatch. Report actual enabled ACL payload capacity and owner credits through HCI. Queue sizes are build resource choices, not chip limits.

commands.name: Disconnect
commands.rule: Unknown handle: 02; invalid reason: 12; success queues termination, not immediate owner release.

commands.name: Read Remote Version Information
commands.rule: Complete via Remote Version Information event, not Command Complete.

commands.name: Set Event Mask
commands.rule: Code e uses bit e-1; command/credit events bypass masks.

commands.name: Reset
commands.rule: Quiesce radio and reset protocol state, masks and credits. Do not carry stale pending owners into the new session.

commands.name: Set Controller To Host Flow Control
commands.rule: Only disable is accepted; enabling unsupported flow control must fail.

commands.name: Read Local Version Information
commands.rule: Return status then 8 bytes. Report only implemented capabilities; zero BD_ADDR is not a usable identity.

commands.name: Read Local Supported Commands
commands.rule: Return status then 64 bytes. Report only implemented capabilities; zero BD_ADDR is not a usable identity.

commands.name: Read Local Supported Features
commands.rule: Return status then 8 bytes. Report only implemented capabilities; zero BD_ADDR is not a usable identity.

commands.name: Read BD_ADDR
commands.rule: Return status then 6 bytes. Report only implemented capabilities; zero BD_ADDR is not a usable identity.

commands.name: Read RSSI
commands.rule: Return status, echoed handle, signed i8 RSSI; unknown handle status 02.

commands.name: LE Set Event Mask
commands.rule: LE subevent s uses bit s-1 and also requires general LE Meta event enable.

commands.name: LE Read Buffer Size
commands.rule: Return status, u16le ACL payload capacity, u8 packet credits; report actual build allocation.

commands.name: LE Read Local Supported Features
commands.rule: Return status and eight feature octets. Advertise only features implemented and accepted for the selected profile.

commands.name: LE Set Random Address

fields.name: address
fields.constraint: static random for shared conformance profile; bits 47:46=11, lower 46 neither all zero nor all one

commands.rule: Reject mutation while advertising/scanning/connected; unsupported address kinds are profile-specific.

commands.name: LE Set Advertising Parameters

fields.name: own_address_type
fields.constraint: Primary legacy subset: 0 or 1; Peripheral checkpoint: 1. Public addressing requires a usable public identity before enable.

commands.rule: Validate before mutating live state. Choose an interval within the requested range. The legacy subset requires a minimum 0x00a0 for nonconnectable/scannable advertising.

commands.name: LE Read Advertising Physical Channel Tx Power
commands.rule: Signed dBm requires calibration evidence; a register preset is not calibrated dBm.

commands.name: LE Set Advertising Data
commands.rule: HCI payload is opaque octets; preserve zeros and padding inside the declared length. Do not reinterpret/truncate AD structures. Trailing bytes outside length are ignored.

commands.name: LE Set Scan Response Data
commands.rule: HCI payload is opaque octets; preserve zeros and padding inside the declared length. Do not reinterpret/truncate AD structures. Trailing bytes outside length are ignored.

commands.name: LE Set Advertising Enable
commands.rule: Enable requires usable own identity and compatible role state. Invalid values: 12; conflicting state: 0c.

commands.name: LE Set Scan Parameters

fields.name: own_address_type
fields.constraint: Primary legacy subset: 0 or 1; Peripheral checkpoint: 1. Public addressing requires a usable public identity before enable.

commands.rule: Reject parameter changes while scanning. Concurrent scanning and connections require an accepted scheduling profile.

commands.name: LE Set Scan Enable
commands.rule: Enable clears duplicate history and starts at advertising channel 37.

commands.name: LE Read Filter Accept List Size
commands.rule: Return the configured filter accept list capacity. Zero capacity must not imply usable list entries.

commands.name: LE Clear Filter Accept List
commands.rule: Clear configured entries only when no active procedure owns the list; reject prohibited live mutation.

commands.name: LE Connection Update
commands.rule: timeout*8 > 2*(latency+1)*interval_max, computed widened. Validate CE length bounds before starting a procedure. Successful Command Status is not proof the update applied; report the asynchronous completion separately.

commands.name: LE Read Channel Map
commands.rule: Return status, handle and five-byte active map; pending map is not active.

commands.name: LE Read Remote Features
commands.rule: Completion is LE Read Remote Features Complete; verify matching handle.

commands.name: LE Rand
commands.rule: Return eight random octets from the configured source. A caller-seeded PRNG alone does not establish entropy or security readiness.

commands.name: LE Read Supported States
commands.rule: Return eight-byte state combinations; absence of concurrent roles must be represented.

events.name: LE Meta
events.layout: subevent:u8, subevent_parameters; connection=01, advertising report=02, update=03, remote features=04, LTK request=05

requirements.text: CH585 is primary; CH582 reductions stay in separate explicit experimental modules.
Little-endian command opcode and lengths; exact packet framing; no out-of-bounds or partial state mutation.
Known command wrong parameter length reports Invalid HCI Command Parameters (12) using its command-complete/status response kind.
Validate advertising fields and state before replacing advertiser settings.
Preserve all declared advertising/scan-response bytes, including zero and malformed AD content.
Validate static random address and reject changes during incompatible active state.
Separate general and LE masks; Command Complete/Status and completed-packet credits cannot be masked.
Validate units, inclusive bounds and strict supervision inequality using widened arithmetic.
Return each accepted ACL credit once, after ACK or explicit cancellation; retries do not create fresh owners.
Cancel old work and restore state/credits without stale packets, queue deadlock or leaked callbacks.
CH585 capture IRQ acknowledges BB bit 6 only before CRC classification; preserve bit 5.
Validate protocol length separately from physical DMA capacity; DMA pointer and mode are chip-specific.
Use CH585 LE1M arithmetic and bounded polls; no transfer of CH582 timing/mode constants.
Independent peer validates discovered identity, read/write/readback, exact notifications and reconnect.
Active traffic spans timer rollover; no probe access, unplanned disconnect, malformed or missing application data.
AES/CCM vectors, packet-counter/nonce retry ownership, MIC rejection and encrypted peer continuity all pass before advertising encryption.
Full CH585 BLE+USB profile has separate SRAM/stack, USB traffic and peer continuity acceptance.
